spec.description: Visual exploration of flight performance, delays, and airline behavior profiles.

spec.title: Q1 — Average Departure Delay Trend (AA vs DL)
spec.description: Monthly comparison of average departure delays (minutes) for American Airlines and Delta Air Lines.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(make_date(2025, month, 1), 'Mon') AS month_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN airline = 'AA' THEN ROUND("dep-delay-mean"::numeric, 1) END) AS "AA (American Airlines)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN airline = 'DL' THEN ROUND("dep-delay-mean"::numeric, 1) END) AS "DL (Delta Air Lines)"
FROM monthly_performance_rdd
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

spec.title: Q4 — Final Airline Classification Matrix
spec.description: Sorted list of airlines with their assigned cluster and full performance metrics for direct comparison.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  carrier,
  prediction AS cluster,
  ROUND(avg_dep_delay::numeric, 2) AS dep_delay,
  ROUND(avg_arr_delay::numeric, 2) AS arr_delay,
  ROUND(avg_flight_makeup::numeric, 2) AS delay_makeup,
  ROUND(arr_delay_stddev::numeric, 2) AS delay_stddev,
  ROUND(cancellation_rate::numeric, 2) AS cancel_rate,
  ROUND(diverted_rate::numeric, 2) AS diverted_rate,
  ROUND(avg_carrier_delay::numeric, 2) AS carrier_d,
  ROUND(avg_weather_delay::numeric, 2) AS weather_d,
  ROUND(avg_nas_delay::numeric, 2) AS nas_d,
  ROUND(avg_security_delay::numeric, 2) AS security_d,
  ROUND(avg_late_aircraft_delay::numeric, 2) AS late_ac_d
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1
ORDER BY prediction, carrier

spec.title: Q4 — Population Distribution by Cluster
spec.description: Count of airlines assigned to each cluster.

spec.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('Cluster ', prediction), count(*) as Airlines FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1 GROUP BY prediction ORDER BY prediction;

spec.title: Q1 — Monthly Cancellation Probability (AA vs DL)
spec.description: Percentage of cancelled flights relative to the total number of scheduled flights per month.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(make_date(2025, month, 1), 'Mon') AS month_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN airline = 'AA' THEN ROUND("cancellation-rate"::numeric, 2) END) AS "AA (American Airlines)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN airline = 'DL' THEN ROUND("cancellation-rate"::numeric, 2) END) AS "DL (Delta Air Lines)"
FROM monthly_performance_rdd
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

spec.title: Q2 — Top 10 Delayed Airlines (Arrival)
spec.description: Airlines with the highest average arrival delays (minimum 500 flights observed).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT carrier, ROUND(arrdelay_mean::numeric, 2) AS avg_arr_delay
FROM arrival_delay_ranking_rdd
ORDER BY avg_arr_delay DESC
LIMIT 10

spec.title: Q2 — Detailed Delay Decomposition by Cause
spec.description: Stack analysis of delay contributors (Carrier, Weather, NAS, Security, Late Aircraft) for the top delayed airlines.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  carrier,
  ROUND(carrier_delay_mean::numeric, 2) AS "Carrier",
  ROUND(weather_delay_mean::numeric, 2) AS "Weather",
  ROUND(nas_delay_mean::numeric, 2) AS "NAS",
  ROUND(security_delay_mean::numeric, 2) AS "Security",
  ROUND(late_aircraft_delay_mean::numeric, 2) AS "Late Aircraft"
FROM arrival_delay_ranking_rdd
ORDER BY arrdelay_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

spec.title: Q3 — Departure Delay Probabilistic Distribution ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Percentiles (p25, p50, p75, p90) showing the hourly spread of departure delays for selected carriers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  hour,
  p25,
  p50,
  p75,
  p90
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_1
WHERE airline = '$TargetCarrier'
ORDER BY hour

spec.title: Q3 — Hourly Median Delay Intensity ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Focus on the median delay (p50) behavior across 24 hours to identify daily bottleneck patterns.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  airline,
  hour,
  p50
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_1
WHERE airline = '$TargetCarrier'
ORDER BY hour

spec.title: Q3 — Absolute Extremes by Carrier ($TargetCarrier)
spec.description: Global minimum and maximum departure delays observed across the entire analysis period.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT airline, min_delay, max_delay
FROM hourly_delay_percentiles_rdd_kll_2
WHERE airline = '$TargetCarrier'

spec.title: Q4 — Latent Performance Clusters (PCA Projection)
spec.description: Mathematical 2D projection of 8D operational features. Small dots = Airlines, Large dots = Cluster Centroids.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  carrier,
  pca_x,
  pca_y,
  prediction AS cluster,
  'Airline' AS type
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'center' as carrier,
  pca_x,
  pca_y,
  cluster,
  'Center' AS type
FROM airline_clustering_dataframe_2
ORDER BY cluster ASC

spec.title: Q4 — Multi-dimensional Centroid Profiles
spec.description: Averages of all 8 performance features for each cluster center, defining the behavior of each identified group.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  'Cluster ' || cluster::text                       AS cluster_label,
  ROUND(avg_dep_delay_center::numeric, 2)           AS "Dep Delay",
  ROUND(avg_arr_delay_center::numeric, 2)           AS "Arr Delay",
  ROUND(avg_flight_makeup_center::numeric, 2)       AS "Delay Makeup",
  ROUND(arr_delay_stddev_center::numeric, 2)        AS "Delay Stddev",
  ROUND(cancellation_rate_center::numeric, 2)       AS "Cancel Rate",
  ROUND(diverted_rate_center::numeric, 2)           AS "Diverted Rate",
  ROUND(avg_carrier_delay_center::numeric, 2)       AS "Carrier D.",
  ROUND(avg_weather_delay_center::numeric, 2)       AS "Weather D.",
  ROUND(avg_nas_delay_center::numeric, 2)           AS "NAS D.",
  ROUND(avg_security_delay_center::numeric, 2)      AS "Security D.",
  ROUND(avg_late_aircraft_delay_center::numeric, 2) AS "Late Ac D."
FROM 
  airline_clustering_dataframe_2
ORDER BY 
  cluster;
